entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: actual production action-defining key drawings for a 2D game death animation, four complete poses in equal padded 2x2 cells, read left-right then top-bottom. Transparent RGBA, no text/grid/effects/floor/shadows. Approved reference is sole design, anatomy, pattern, palette, camera and original proportions authority. Keep same character world scale in every cell with generous margin and a common ground line, no zoom-to-fit and no body shrinking, melting or global squash. The four phases are NORMAL ALIVE NEUTRAL (fully open eyes), SUPPORT FAILING (joint articulation and center of mass losing balance), FIRST WEIGHT CONTACT (whole body reaches ground), then PASSIVE FOLLOW-THROUGH SETTLED CORPSE. Draw actual body/limb poses and overlaps; no mere head tilt or erased limbs. Preserve skull size, torso volume, appendage lengths and marking placement. Key3 and Key4 body position should be identical once contacted, only designated soft appendages finish settling. Original fine outlines and painterly shading, no gore. Exact tortoise: moss-gray green big round head/neck and four chunky short legs with pale toes, a large rigid mountain shell of brown/gray rocks, golden mineral seams and tall pale turquoise crystals. Mineral shell/stone/crystal outlines and mass stay unchanged. Neutral exact alive head/legs extended, eyes open. Failing: front knees bend distinctly, head/neck droops and begins withdrawing; rear legs respond late under the huge weight, rigid whole mountain tips slightly as support fails. Contact: head and limbs fold/retract into the shell in correct order, rock mass lowers rigidly onto original ground. Settled: no head, limbs or tail exposed, ONLY the mineral/crystal shell rests on ground, with the same exact crystal count, shape and rock pattern. No crushed/melted stones, floating shell, or legs simply erased. The weight of the load should be evident.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Actual production four COMPLETE in-between cels, 2x2 equal padded cells, true transparent RGBA no scenery/shadow/glow/text/grid. Image1 pose A, image2 pose B, image3 APPROVED design authority. Draw 20%,40%,60%,80% progress A to B, excluding endpoints. Same exact character world scale/camera/ground within each 512-square cel, no per-cel zoom, skull growth, body melting, marking drift or limb deletion. True joint articulation and changing overlap under gravity. Tortoise front knees buckle while paws initially planted; huge heavy mineral load starts settling, hind legs react later. Head/neck lowers and retracts into shell in a real curved neck motion, eyes close late. All short chunky leg joints articulate inward with constant bone/toe lengths, body flesh slips under fixed shell rim instead of vanishing. Last cel approaches B tucked head/feet, ready to fully withdraw. Keep exact rigid rocks/crystal count/shape/mineral seams; no elastic mountain, shrunken head, added paws or static legs with only head nod.
